set.body:
## Objective and scope

Extend the existing same-affine ANTs lane so anatomical and geometry comparisons are independently checked on exactly the same inputs.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Reproduce the existing five-pair comparison and identify the selected HalfFlow source/config; verify all affine coefficients, RAS/LPS direction, map reload, image resampling and full input identities.
2. Run both exported map directions through common independent inverse, coverage and cell-topology checks; record ANTs failures and region differences without silently weakening HalfFlow admission.
3. Publish quality-versus-runtime curves on named native hardware with controlled threads, including a comparable-budget lane and generous-convergence reference; keep emulated timing separate.
4. Save all maps/receipts and per-structure metrics. Comparator completion alone does not mean comparator geometry passed; qualification cannot rely on an unresolved or invalid reference.

## Planned areas

- benchmarks/flashalign/ants_same_affine.py
- benchmarks/flashalign/real_mri_cell_topology.py
- benchmarks/flashalign/runner/
- docs/benchmarks/

## Blocking prerequisites

- P01 (`bd-01M4X4DXPNC41BN15X9MBD7HGY`)

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.

## References

- docs/benchmarks/real-image-development.md (2026-10-11 accumulated-smoothing and backtracking studies)
- docs/halfflow-capability-ledger.md
- Existing refinement issue bd-01M4NVC83PEY6F4GSGDRD6RFBH and full-boundary issue bd-01M2EG25H20DR7CXNHK22ZF4VE
- Same-affine reference: docs/benchmarks/evidence/real-mri-calibration-20261011/reference-results.json
- SyN method: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2276735/
- Independent evaluation reference: https://github.com/JHU-MedImage-Reg/LUMIR_L2R
set.title: HFQ-P02: Audit the same-affine SyN reference and common evaluator
